name: Transco SouthCoast Expansion
researcher_notes: Transco SouthCoast Expansion was placed in service on November 1, 2000. No existing row covers it: the Transco rows are the main line system row P0271 and later expansion projects. A Federal Register notice from November 23, 1999 describes about 44.3 miles of pipeline and 31,500 horsepower of compression in Choctaw, Marengo, Coosa, and Chilton Counties, Alabama, and Walton, Gwinnett, Coweta, and Henry Counties, Georgia (docket CP99-392). The EIA August 2026 project table (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 164) lists 44 miles, 200 million cubic feet per day, 108 million dollars, completed 2000, with states AL and GA. The Transco annual report for 1999 was also searched and names the project. The 200 and 108 million figures were read from the EIA row and a search summary of the Transco filings; the annual report text was not read in full for those two values, so the tier is medium. Length is 44.3 miles from the notice, which is above the 25 km threshold. The row follows the Hillabee expansion pattern: pipeline name is the parent system and segment name is the project. Owner and parent copy the style of the existing Hillabee row. Route not found; no public geometry was located. Diameters (24, 42, 48 inches per EIA) are left blank because the segments differ.
